collection.description: A child finds a dazzling gem in a riverbed that a jeweler suspects is glass.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A child finds a dazzling 'gem' in a riverbed. An adult jeweler suspects it is ordinary glass.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The child keeps it as a lucky token and begins collecting river treasures.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They discover how light and fractures can mislead the eye; the child gains curiosity, not shame.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The supposedly worthless glass becomes the village's most talked-about pendant.
